item.title: Monaco United Women secure final four spot in Mediterranean Cup
item.description: Monaco United Women pulled off a notable upset on Sunday, winning against FC Rousset to reach the Mediterranean Cup semi finals, despite competing two divisions below their opponents.

item.title: Who are the Michelin inspectors — and what are they actually looking for?
item.description: They eat more than 250 meals a year, always anonymously, always paying the bill. With the Michelin ceremony just weeks away in Monaco, here is how the stars are really decided.

item.title: Some flights resume from UAE but hundreds of thousands remain stranded across the Middle East
item.description: A small number of flights have departed Dubai and Abu Dhabi, offering limited relief to the hundreds of thousands of passengers caught up in the worst aviation disruption the Middle East has seen in years.

item.title: 42nd Primo Cup-UBS Trophy Returns to Monaco this week
item.description: The Yacht Club de Monaco plays host to one of the Mediterranean's most anticipated one design regattas this week, as the 42nd Primo Cup-UBS Trophy gets underway from 5th to 8th March.

item.title: Verdi’s Il Trovatore comes to the Opéra de Monte-Carlo this March with a stellar international cast
item.description: The Opéra de Monte-Carlo presents Verdi's Il Trovatore across four performances this month, in a co-production with the Teatro Real de Madrid and the Royal Danish Opera that brings together some of the most celebrated voices in opera today.

item.title: Polar science is advancing fast – but who’s paying for it?
item.description: The Monaco Polar Symposium put climate research on centre stage, but the harder question is who foots the bill.

item.title: PokerStars becomes first gaming partner of the Rolex Monte-Carlo Masters
item.description: The Rolex Monte-Carlo Masters has announced a partnership with PokerStars, marking the first time the tournament has signed an official agreement with a gaming brand.

item.title: Interview: Photographer Franck Solimeis brings Japan to Monaco
item.description: Le Méridien Beach Plaza has opened a unique photography exhibition called 'Japan Highlights', by self taught Monégasque photographer Franck Solimeis.

item.title: Italian fashion brand Twinset to show at Monte-Carlo Fashion Week
item.description: The label will close this year's event with a Ready-to-Buy collection and evening wear on 18 April.

item.title: Monaco to go zero waste for the fifth edition of MonaCollecte
item.description: Zero-waste cooking, homemade cosmetics, recycled plastic builds and a VR sorting centre — Monaco's two-day sustainability festival has something for every age group.
